sentences.text: Also heard on I.A.No.19829/2025, which is second application under Section 389 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail and suspension of remaining jail sentence.

3. Appellant has been convicted for the offence under Sections 376(1) and 324 of IPC and sentenced to suffer ten years RI with fine of Rs.5000/- with usual default stipulation and one year RI.
4.
Learned counsel for the appellant contended that the appellant has been wrongly convicted by the Trial Court on the basis of improper appreciation of evidence.
Appellant has served five years jail incarceration which is more than 50% of the awarded jail sentence of 10 years.
His earlier application for suspension of jail sentence has been dismissed as withdrawn.
DNA report was found negative.
Appellant is 60 years old person.

Final conclusion of this appeal would take long time,
hence the appellant may be released on bail and his remaining jail sentence may be suspended till final disposal of this appeal.
5. Per contra, learned counsel for the State opposed the prayer and 2 CRA-1477-2023 prayed for its rejection by submitting that other criminal antecedent has been found against the appellant.
He is habitual offender.
6. In reply, counsel for the appellant submitted that in the case which was registered in 1998, he has served entire jail sentence.
7. Both the parties are heard and perused the record.

sentences.text:
Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and also taking note of the fact that appellant has been previously convicted but no improvement has been done in his conduct, he has committed serious offence of rape, prosecutrix categorically deposed against the appellant regarding the aforesaid offence and her statement is well supported by statements of other witnesses and the FIR,
there is no material change in the circumstances, this Court is of the considered opinion that it is not a fit case for grant of bail.
It is accordingly, dismissed on merit.
9. Registry is directed to list the matter for final hearing in due course.
10. Certified copy as per rules.
(ANIL VERMA) JUDGE (alok)
